component.name: Shoggoth
component.summary: Heavy on the cosmos. Light on your machine

description.p: Shoggoth is one download that runs open-weights language models on your own hardware. Chat with them, draw diagrams, write documents, or let a model read and change the files in a folder while you watch. Shoggoth gives you the complete setup without needing much technical know-how.

ul.li: Private by default: chats run on your computer. Web search asks first.
Works on your files: choose a folder and the model reads, searches and edits it while you watch, asking before it changes anything.
Models that fit your computer: Shoggoth suggests models for your hardware and downloads them for you.

screenshot.caption: Working in a folder: the model fixes a bug and runs the tests again.
Models: recommended picks for each size, with one button to set up and get them.
The Getting ready screen: set up the engine for your graphics card and pick a first model.
